payload.explanation: The business request (session_bda0d96099e1, UPDATE inventory stock-1 for product_id=2) is blocked on transactionid by session_bb39ccc58c5d, which in turn is blocked by session_a34e1ccef072 — an 'idle in transaction' session holding an uncommitted UPDATE on inventory (product_id=1) while waiting on ClientRead. Tracing the chain via pg_blocking_pids, the upstream root blocker is session_a34e1ccef072; the eligible remediation is rollback_session on that idle transaction, which will release the lock chain and let the business decrement complete. No evidence of large data, index, or vacuum issues (tiny table, PK-only index, no dead tuples); uncertainty is minimal, though lock ages were not directly observed.
